scenario_description:
Objective: Keep the September steering clinic usable by satisfying its dock-swim sticker prerequisite before roster verification.
Emerging Need: A new office rule makes the future clinic depend on a current sticker, while the stored profile record is needed to know whether the requirement is already met.
Decision Context: Early notices withhold signup, then a short reversible hold window opens for the only refresher before the clinic and requires the member ID.
Consequence: If the signup sheet closes, the clinic remains scheduled but the missing prerequisite cannot be added to the accepted roster in time.

parameter.title: Rainwake intro stern steering clinic
parameter.description: Evening on-water steering clinic with dock check-in before launch.

parameter.subject: Steering clinic dock-office update
parameter.body: For the September 2 intro stern steering clinic, the lake office added a 2026 dock-swim sticker check at roster verification. Paddlers without a current sticker must complete the brief float-check refresher before the clinic. Makeup lane details will be posted after the lifejacket inventory is confirmed; please do not send hold requests yet.

parameter.content: Dock captain says the refresher lane is still waiting on inventory signoff. Earliest possible makeup is Thursday evening, but the spreadsheet is not open yet, so they are ignoring early claims.

parameter.subject: Thursday float-check refresher signup open
parameter.body: The only float-check refresher before the September 2 steering clinic is now open for paddlers needing a 2026 dock-swim sticker. Four reversible holds are available Thursday at 18:20 and 18:40. Reply by Wednesday August 26 at 16:00 with Rainwake member ID and preferred time; the sheet then goes to the lake office for roster verification.

parameter.subject: Float-check sheet sent for Sep 2 clinic
parameter.body: The Thursday refresher sheet has been sent to the lake office. Unclaimed holds were released, and the office will only accept 2026 dock-swim sticker updates from this sheet for next Wednesday's steering clinic roster.
